integrity: Proof is analytical; attached exact-rational finite enumeration and numerical LP checks independently test representative finite parameters but are not infinite certificates.
scientific_limitations: Exact results only for the additive baseline game with the sole exceptional coalition U, u,d>=1, a,b>0, signed efficient payoffs and all proper-coalition constraints. They do not extend by assertion to general contextual models or constrained imputations. The full Nagarajan et al. (2026) primary manuscript was inaccessible and may affect literature priority.
title: Exact simplex-product least core and Shapley sign gap for contextual distractors
